title: General Utilities
summary: This module provides a collection of general-purpose utility functions and classes, including tools for asynchronous iteration, HTML parsing, Pydantic model handling, and system information retrieval.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Iterator Tee
nodes.title: Asynchronous Iterator Tee
nodes.description: Splits a single asynchronous iterable into multiple independent iterators, buffering items until all child iterators have consumed them.

nodes.label: Synchronous Iterator Tee
nodes.title: Synchronous Iterator Tee
nodes.description: Splits a single synchronous iterable into multiple independent iterators, buffering items until all child iterators have consumed them.

nodes.label: HTML Link Extractor
nodes.title: HTML Link Extractor
nodes.description: Extracts and normalizes sub-links from an HTML string, converting them to absolute paths and filtering based on various criteria.

nodes.label: Pydantic Utilities
nodes.title: Pydantic Utilities
nodes.description: Provides utility functions for Pydantic models, such as a wrapper for `__init__` to handle default values and a function to get the Pydantic major version.

nodes.label: Validation Wrapper
nodes.title: Validation Wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that validates function arguments, ensuring that exactly one argument in specified groups is non-None.

nodes.label: System Information Printer
nodes.title: System Information Printer
nodes.description: Prints detailed system and package information for debugging and environment analysis.

nodes.label: Version Consistency Checker
nodes.title: Version Consistency Checker
nodes.description: Validates version consistency across `pyproject.toml`, `version.py`, and snapshot files within the project.

groups.label: Iteration Helpers
groups.title: Iteration Helpers
groups.description: Provides utilities for handling both synchronous and asynchronous iterators, including teeing functionality.

groups.label: Data Transformation
groups.title: Data Transformation
groups.description: Contains utilities for parsing and transforming data, such as extracting links from HTML.

groups.label: Model and Validation
groups.title: Model and Validation Utilities
groups.description: Offers tools for working with Pydantic models and general argument validation.

groups.label: System Diagnostics
groups.title: System Diagnostics and Versioning
groups.description: Includes functions for printing system information and ensuring version consistency across project files.
